title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative NS and nondimensionalization described; physical result accuracy assessed separately.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS multizone TRI/QUAD/BAR reader and adjacency; MIXED sections explicitly unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face conservative residual and wall/farfield paths implemented; final averaging can invalidate plateau assumption.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Roe/Rusanov numerical flux choices exist; first-order farfield sponge disclosed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths and boundary-state surface output present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ reconstruction and limiter active after disclosed startup; M200 laminar only748 steps after 12500 first-order steps.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkatakrishnan and positivity controls exist; transient limiter frozen at predictor and report discloses it.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier terms and explicit tangential force projection residual.cpp:202–215.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS and averaged-state plateau method exist, but final500 force means shift after acceptance without a new test.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2/GMRES and periodic St0.160 supported; reported target ratio uses predictor-frozen limiter, refreshed-limiter strict behavior unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only mesh preprocessing, METIS and neighbor halos; short rank diagnostics not converged and Re20 differs ~2.4%.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
